cases.title: 奥德修斯向下爬梯
cases.camera: locked full-body medium wide side view

start.actor: one Odysseus on upper ladder; torso faces wooden horse; hands grip both rails; feet on upper rungs

end.actor: same Odysseus exactly two rungs lower, facing horse, hands grip rails, feet still on ladder

invariants: sword stays sheathed at left hip
one rigid wooden horse facing right
acceptance: pelvis visibly moves down at least two rungs
no upward travel or direction reversal
both hands alternate secure ladder grips
identity, sword sheath and horse remain stable

cases.title: 剑矛交锋对照

start.odysseus: left foreground right-hand sword raised before parry; left hand empty
start.guard: right foreground spear thrust beginning; left shield

end.odysseus: same left foreground sword high right after parry; left hand empty
end.guard: same right foreground recoils one half-step after spear deflection; shield left
end.extras: same two background pairs at next fight phase

invariants: guard keeps right spear and left shield
acceptance: visible spear thrust and sword parry

cases.title: 双人抬闩与掩护

start.bar: one wooden bar horizontal and seated in two wall brackets
start.operators: Odysseus left and young Greek right grip bar with both hands
start.extras: three Greeks and two Trojans fighting at right

end.bar: same bar lifted 25cm vertically clear above both brackets, held horizontally in front of closed gate
end.operators: same two actors, both hands still carry bar
end.extras: same five cover fighters continue at right

invariants: young soldier shield stays on back
acceptance: two operators jointly lift the bar clear of both brackets
no shield appears in operators hands

cases.title: 大军团持续群战
cases.camera: locked elevated wide master shot; no crane this regression

start.foreground: two readable Greek/Trojan sword-shield combat pairs, attack preparation
start.middle: blue-gray and rust-colored infantry fighting around both sides of horse
start.background: dense opposing armies clash between open left gate and right fountain
start.horse: one rigid horse, hatch up, ladder down

end.foreground: same four foreground fighters after blocked strikes, half-step recoil
end.middle: same armies advance and recoil during combat
end.background: same dense clash with weapons raised

invariants: one horse, one hatch, one ladder
gate open on left and fountain on right
acceptance: both foreground pairs visibly strike, block and recoil
middle and rear lines fight rather than parade or stand still
no living horse motion or hero duplication

camera_change_from_v1: locked in all four regression cases
quality_gate: manual criteria; technical decode PASS does not imply creative acceptance
